verses.text: "Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it like a barber's razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair into three parts.

When the days of your siege are over, burn a third of the hair in the fire in the middle of the city. Take another third and strike it with the sword all around the city. Scatter the last third to the wind, because I will chase them with a drawn sword.
But take a few hairs and tuck them into the folds of your robe.
Take a few of these, throw them into the fire, and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to all the people of Israel.
This is what the Lord GOD says: This is Jerusalem. I have put her in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
But in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and rules even more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my rules.

So this is what the Lord GOD says: You have caused more trouble than the nations around you. You have not followed my rules or kept my laws. You have not even kept the standards of the nations around you.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I myself am against you. I will punish you while the nations watch.
Because of all your disgusting idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
So among you parents will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will punish you and scatter all your survivors to every wind.

So as surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, because you have made my holy place unclean with all your vile images and disgusting practices, I myself will cut you down. I will not look on you with pity or spare you.

A third of your people will die of disease or starve to death inside your walls. A third will be killed by the sword outside your walls. And I will scatter a third to every wind and chase them with a drawn sword.
Then my anger will be spent, and my fury against them will calm down. I will be satisfied. And when I have spent my fury on them, they will know that I, the LORD, have spoken in my jealous love.
I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of everyone who passes by.
You will be a disgrace and an object of mockery, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I punish you in anger and fury and with furious rebukes. I, the LORD, have spoken.
I will shoot at you with deadly arrows of famine meant to destroy you. I will make the famine worse and cut off your food supply.

I will send famine and wild animals against you, and they will take your children from you. Disease and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken."
